id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the filter string needs to take case-sensitivity into account.

filterComparator.description: The comparator to use when generating the filter expression with the new search query.

isLoading.description:
Whether the search is loading or not.
This is an internal state, developers should not touch it manually.

replaceArgument.description:
The argument in the data source API to replace with the new (and maybe transformed) search query string.
By default, the argument is `spec`, assuming it is a fetch call with a filter spec.

dataSourceFieldMaps.description:
A private cache of field {@link ValueType} maps for each datasource associated with this component. Use
{@link getFieldMapForDatasource} as an interface with this field; do not use 'dataSourceFieldMaps' directly.

activeFilters.description:
A mapping of componentId to the filter string generated by that component, so that all strings can be combined
when generating the filter string.
For example, `{ SDL.ExampleGrid: 'id == "SomeID"', SDL.ExampleFilterPanel: 'name == "SomeName"' }` would be
combined to form the filter string `'( id == "SomeID" ) && ( name == "SomeName" )'`.

dataPath.description: The path in the data source to get the data.

disabled.description: If true, displays the input form field as 'disabled', with a non-interactable input.

displayField.description: The display field for each search result. Should be a valid field returned in the data source collection.

field.description: The value field for each result. Should be a valid field returned in the data source collection.

fluid.description: When set to true this input will take up the full width of its container.

generateFilter.description: Whether or not the argument to insert in the new search call is a filter spec. `true` by default.

hint.description: The label to display underneath the input field.

invalid.description: If true, displays the input form field as 'invalid', with red text, icons, and borders.

label.description: The label to put above the input.

loadInitialData.description: Whether to load dropdown results initially, based on an empty search query. Defaulted to `false`.

noResultsMessage.description: The message to display when data returned in the search is empty.

openOnFocus.description: Whether to show the dropdown list when search is focused (true), or only show it on search change (false).

openOnResultsChange.description:
Controls whether or not to show the dropdown when search results are updated. This can be set to false
when search is being used with a grid, for example, where change in the search query is filtering the rows.
Note: If {@link openOnFocus} is set to `true`, that will override this configuration.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text to display in the input element.

searchDataSource.description: The name of the data source to fetch search results from.

searchFields.description:
The list of fields in the data source that are used in the fetch filter.
Relevant if {@link generateFilter} is true.

title: A component that allow you to search on a given data source.
name: UiSdlSearch
